requirement: Students record themselves reading aloud, practicing appropriate pacing, intonation, and expression. Focus: Enhancing oral reading expression and rate. Examples: Reading a dialogue between characters, reading an enthusiastic informative paragraph, reading a short poem, reading an empathetic narrative, reading a persuasive sentence, reading a list of exclamatory remarks. Constraints: Use audio analysis in the read-aloud-studio to compare against a model reading.
